label.zh: 玄关 · 家务 · 回廊

description.zh: 净开目标1.20m，单扇向西旁侧轨道停放；不是在本1.2m洞内双扇互推。窗前停车、150mm实垛、轨道、密封与实际净开须一并选型核验。
description.en: Target clear opening 1.20 m: one leaf parks to the west on a side track, rather than two leaves overlapping within this 1.2 m aperture. Verify parking in front of glazing, the 150 mm pier, track, seals and actual clear width together.

detail.zh: 独立通风、电源与有线网络；柜门向西检修，型号待定。
detail.en: Independent ventilation, power and wired network; service access faces west. Equipment remains undecided.

detail.zh: 2.9×0.9m长案以毡垫展开纸本，东端独立洗笔槽；自然木质与米白纸墙，不叠加古典装饰。
detail.en: A 2.9 × 0.9 m felt-topped paper-work desk with a separate eastern brush basin, natural timber and paper-toned walls.

label.zh: 归家 · 放下包 · 工作
label.en: Arrive · put down a bag · work

label.zh: 归家 · 回廊 · 起居 · 入庭
夜间 · 回廊 · 安睡
画室入口 · 挂轴 · 洗笔长案

label.en: Media room · toward the north screen

label.zh: 泳池 · 从西南池畔看
外庭 · 朝主宅与生活翼
label.en: Outer garden · toward the core and wing

label.zh: 茶与听音 · 日常深化

description.zh: 柜上烧水、坐下冲泡、收杯、清洗和归柜在同一茶湾内闭环。主通行改经回廊；热电壶留在柜上，小保温壶送到茶桌，坐姿干泡不横越归家或夜间路线。
description.en: Heat water at the counter, brew while seated, then wash and store within one tea bay. Main circulation uses the gallery; the electric kettle stays put while a small insulated server supplies the seated ritual.

description.zh: 独立茶洗槽接收茶水与杯具；洗笔另在画室，不借用食品或茶水槽。
description.en: A dedicated tea sink handles cups and tea waste. Brush washing has its own studio basin.

description.zh: 洗后在水槽旁沥干，再擦干归柜；不把湿杯直接放入干茶抽屉。
description.en: Drain next to the sink, dry, then store. Keep wet cups out of the dry-tea drawers.

description.zh: 电壶固定在耐热柜面，不端着通电或沸腾的电壶跨主路；具体温度按所泡茶类决定。
description.en: Keep the electric kettle on its heat-resistant counter, away from main circulation. Select water temperature for the tea.

description.zh: 柜上烧水后装入小保温壶，加盖托盘送至茶桌；0.55m只是人员局部服务站位间隔，不是器具全程。
description.en: Fill a small insulated server at the counter and carry it covered on the tray. The 0.55 m measure describes local standing positions, not the complete vessel journey.

description.zh: 直径1.2m、桌高0.68m三人茶席，配茶盘、壶承/公道杯位置、小保温壶和废水盂；坐下冲泡与品饮，茶水柜负责烧水和洗涤。
description.en: A 1.2 m-diameter, 0.68 m-high table for three, with a tray, brewing / serving space, insulated server and waste bowl. Brew and drink seated; heat and wash at the counter.

description.zh: 灯位对准茶桌，不作为穿行区低垂障碍。
description.en: The pendant sits above the table, outside walking routes.

spec.zh: 暖色可调光；下沿研究高度1.70m，显色、眩光与实物样板待核。
spec.en: Warm dimmable light; concept lower edge 1.70 m. Verify rendering, glare and a physical sample.

description.zh: 连续照亮水槽、沥水、烧水和托盘区。
description.en: Light the sink, drying, heating and clean-tray zones together.

spec.zh: 2.30m线性工作灯；清洗场景优先操作照度，回路与灯型未定。
spec.en: 2.30 m linear task light; prioritize useful light for cleaning. Circuit and product remain open.

description.zh: 灯光停留在读书椅与唱片柜附近，不照向显示器或卧室。
description.en: Keep reading light by the chair and audio cabinet.

spec.zh: 独立开关、局部照明；底座F-L19。
spec.en: Independent local light; base footprint F-L19.

description.zh: 从回廊入起居时可切换茶、听音、清洗和独处。
description.en: Choose tea, music, cleaning or solitude on entering from the gallery.

spec.zh: 靠P01东门垛；可用物理按键，不依赖手机。
spec.en: Beside the east jamb of P01; physical controls remain usable without a phone.

description.zh: 插座在烧水区后方，与西侧茶洗槽分开。
description.en: An outlet behind the heating zone, separated from the western sink.

spec.zh: 独立可断电；负荷、保护与防溅规格由电气专业核定。
spec.en: Individually switchable; an electrician must determine load, protection and splash requirements.

description.zh: 电源与信号在唱片柜后检修；不沿D09门槛铺活动线。
description.en: Service power behind the record cabinet; no loose cable crosses D09.

spec.zh: 柜后可检修；扬声器线沿北侧与西侧柜边暗藏，实际走线待声学/电气协调。
spec.en: Keep service access. Conceal speaker runs along cabinetry and the west edge after acoustic/electrical coordination.

description.zh: 在洁净托盘一端预留，不放在水槽正上方。
description.en: Reserve power at the clean-tray end, away from directly above the sink.

spec.zh: 用途与数量待设备清单确定；不用插线板堆叠。
spec.en: Finalize use and count from the equipment inventory; avoid piled extension strips.

description.zh: 唱片、流媒体和未来设备可共用可检修信号位。
description.en: Provide serviceable connections for records, streaming and future equipment.

spec.zh: 强弱电分路策略待专业深化，不把线缆跨通道外露。
spec.en: Coordinate signal/power separation professionally; keep cables off walking routes.

description.zh: 给水在水槽柜内可检修。
description.en: Keep the supply accessible inside the sink cabinet.

spec.zh: 过滤、检修阀与防漏措施待设备选择。
spec.en: Specify filtration, isolation and leak measures after equipment selection.

description.zh: 湿区沿北服务带向餐厨协调，不以图中折线代替真实排水坡度。
description.en: Coordinate drainage along the northern service strip toward the kitchen; a diagram is not a drainage-gradient design.

spec.zh: 先弃茶渣后冲洗；存水弯、坡度、穿梁和清扫口由机电核验。
spec.en: Remove leaves before rinsing. Verify traps, falls, structure crossings and cleaning access professionally.

description.zh: 西端独立香品格与可取出无明火扩香盘，远离干茶、烧水和音响；泡茶时关闭并收起。
description.en: A closed western scent drawer and removable flame-free tray, away from tea, heating and audio. Close and put away for tea.

spec.zh: 不用明火、雾化水汽或常开扩香；气味不代替通风，可完全撤掉。
spec.en: No flame, mist or continuous diffusion. Scent does not replace ventilation and can be removed entirely.

description.zh: 留给存水弯、阀门与可取出的废水/茶渣处理，不装干茶。
description.en: Reserve room for trap, valves and removable tea-waste handling; no dry tea here.

description.zh: 常用杯在上、备用杯在下；洗后擦干再归位。
description.en: Daily cups above, spares below; dry them before storing.

description.zh: 烧水壶下不放干茶，保留耐热耗材、托盘与检修；茶布分干湿归位。
description.en: No dry tea beneath the kettle; keep heat-tolerant supplies, trays and access here.

label.en: Dry-tea tins at the clean end

description.zh: 干茶在最东洁净端密封内盒，与烧水格设隔热分隔；温湿度和存量仍需试用核验。
description.en: Store sealed dry tea at the eastern clean end, thermally separated from the heating module. Check temperature, humidity and real inventory.

description.zh: 热电壶留柜上，小保温壶加盖置托盘送茶席；图示0.55m是东北侧人员局部站位间隔，不是器具全程；不跨主路。
description.en: Keep the electric kettle on the counter and carry a covered insulated server on the tray. The 0.55 m line is a local standing interval, not the complete vessel journey; main routes stay separate.

label.zh: 收杯 · 清洗 · 归柜

description.zh: 从东北服务位收杯，沿茶柜前回到西侧洗槽，再沥干归柜；干湿操作分端。
description.en: Collect at the northeast service point, return along the counter to the west sink, then dry and store.

description.zh: 从ST02取干杯、ST03取茶布托盘、ST04取密封干茶，先在柜上布置；主路保持畅通。
description.en: Take cups from ST02, cloth / trays from ST03 and sealed dry tea from ST04; prepare on the counter and keep circulation clear.

description.zh: 在TS03烧水，装入小保温壶后加盖、置洁净托盘送茶席；电水壶保持原位，温度按茶类决定。
description.en: Heat at TS03, then cover the small insulated server and carry it on the clean tray. Keep the electric kettle in place; select temperature for the tea.

description.zh: 在TS05茶盘上坐姿干泡，用壶承、公道杯和小废水盂完成仪式；TR01标局部服务站位，不把沸壶穿过归家路径。
description.en: Brew seated at the TS05 tray with brewing / serving space and a small waste bowl. TR01 marks local service positions rather than carrying a boiling kettle through arrival routes.

description.zh: 茶渣先入可取出的容器，杯具到TS01；不用茶水槽处理画材。
description.en: Collect leaves before washing cups at TS01; keep art materials out of this sink.

description.zh: TS02沥干、擦干、回到对应柜格；夜间只留局部灯光。
description.en: Drain at TS02, dry, return to the correct module and leave only local evening light.

description.zh: 柜上烧水、坐下干泡，茶柜工作灯与茶席灯分层开启；主路绕过操作区，香品关闭收起。
description.en: Heat at the counter and brew seated under layered light; keep main routes clear and put scent products away.

description.zh: 茶柜灯关闭或调暗，听位回到沙发中央；三角形只是约60°试摆起点。
description.en: Dim the counter, sit at the sofa centre and treat the approximately 60° triangle as a listening trial.

description.zh: 提高柜面工作照明，先弃渣再洗杯，沥干归柜后结束。
description.en: Use task light; remove leaves, wash, dry and reset.

description.zh: 只留阅读灯或低亮茶灯；香气可选、可撤，机器与工作仍在可关门的书房。
description.en: Keep local light and optional removable scent while work and machines remain behind the study door.

description.zh: 主听位(2.80,6.80)，两箱中心距2.02m、左右听距约2.02m，夹角约60.0°。这是一组可试听的约60°试摆；窗面反射、帘布、音量和0–20°内倾仍需现场调，不承诺茶席每个座位都是主听位。
description.en: The main seat (2.80, 6.80) has a 2.02 m speaker span, approximately 2.02 m listening distances and a 60.0° angle. This is an adjustable approximately 60° trial. Tune glass reflections, curtains, level and 0–20° toe-in on site; tea seats are not all sweet spots.

description.zh: 西段F-L08独立闭合香品格与F-L20可取出扩香盘；与干茶和音响分开。只在独处场景按需短时使用，泡茶时关闭收起，不设置明火和雾化水汽。
description.en: A closed scent compartment in F-L08 and removable F-L20 tray stay separate from tea and audio. Optional short use during solitude; close and put away for tea. No flame or mist.

description.zh: 1190㎡假想地块，用于园居关系研究，不是真实土地、测绘或可获批的用地结论。主宅200㎡保持独立核算，新增翼房与泳池按分期另列。
description.en: A hypothetical 1,190 m² parcel for spatial study, not actual land, a survey or an approval. The 200 m² core remains separate from a phased wing and outdoor pool.

description.zh: 200㎡概念建面含166㎡净功能；原15.54㎡预留室成为可逆画室，30㎡内庭另列。
description.en: 200 m² gross concept includes 166 m² net; the existing 15.54 m² room becomes a reversible art studio. The 30 m² court is separate.

label.zh: 二期 · 影音与健身翼

description.zh: 独立东南翼60㎡净功能，加12㎡构造设备预留，合72㎡新增概念建面。
description.en: A detached southeast wing adds 60 m² net plus 12 m² allowance, or 72 m² additional gross concept.

description.zh: 36㎡水面与54㎡池畔为室外面积；先确认维护、用水、机房和四边安全围界。
description.en: 36 m² water and 54 m² deck are outdoors. Resolve maintenance, water, plant and a four-sided safety enclosure first.

description.zh: 图示沿用166㎡净功能控制线；200㎡概念建面含34㎡构造设备预留，不能把14×14包围盒当实测外廓。
description.en: The drawing retains the 166 m² net control geometry. The 200 m² gross concept includes a 34 m² allowance; its 14 × 14 bounding box is not a surveyed envelope.

description.zh: 15.54㎡已在主宅166㎡净功能内；不再重复增加建筑面积。
description.en: 15.54 m² is already inside the core net area; it is not additional floor area.

description.zh: 3×6m露天停车位与邻近单车/快递格属于室外预留，不默认为车库建筑面积。
description.en: A 3 × 6 m open parking bay with nearby cycle / parcel storage is an outdoor reservation, not assumed garage floor area.

description.zh: 6×4m净空间，留可移动器材与伸展；荷载、振动和通风待设备清单核验。
description.en: A 6 × 4 m net room for movable equipment and stretching; verify load, vibration and ventilation from the equipment list.

label.zh: 淋浴 · 更衣 · 设备

description.zh: 与健身、影音分隔，服务泳池与翼房；湿区和设备房仍需专业划分。
description.en: Separate support for the pool and wing; professionally divide wet services and plant space.

description.zh: 6×4m净空间，避开卧室共墙；隔声、低频与静音通风优先，不把软包当隔音。
description.en: A 6 × 4 m net room without a shared bedroom wall. Prioritize isolation, bass control and quiet ventilation.

description.zh: 12×3m的36㎡水面属于后期室外愿景；水深、结构、处理系统和审批未定。
description.en: A 12 × 3 m, 36 m² water area is a later outdoor study; depth, structure, treatment and approvals remain open.

description.zh: 15×6m围合范围扣除36㎡水面，池畔净54㎡；不计室内建面。
description.en: A 15 × 6 m enclosure minus 36 m² water leaves 54 m² deck, separate from indoor floor area.

description.zh: 1.2m研究步道连接归家入口和独立翼，不要求穿过泳池围界。
description.en: A 1.2 m study path links the entrance and detached wing without entering the pool enclosure.

description.zh: 健身、设备和影音各从西侧步道到达，夜间噪声与湿脚不穿卧室。
description.en: A west-side path serves the gym, services and media room without crossing bedrooms.

description.zh: 从EG01南侧门到外园，再经独立泳池安全门PG01入池畔；入口不借主宅门替代。
description.en: Leave through EG01, then enter the pool deck through its own PG01 safety gate.

description.zh: 通过翼内门ED04到更衣淋浴，不穿影音室。
description.en: Use internal ED04 for changing / showering, without crossing the media room.

description.zh: 经ED02回外部步道，再从PG01入池畔，干湿路径不借影音座位穿行。
description.en: Leave through ED02, follow the external path and enter PG01; wet traffic never crosses media seating.

description.zh: 从假想东侧接路面经EG02步行门，绕翼房北侧到D01；不穿健身房。
description.en: Walk through EG02 and around the north of the wing to D01, without crossing the gym.

description.zh: 东侧EG03车行口通露天车位；与步行门分开，实际转弯与接路待基地测绘。
description.en: EG03 serves open parking separately from the pedestrian gate; turning and actual road access await a real survey.

description.zh: 设备维护从东侧外部通路到ED05，不穿卧室、茶室或泳池围界。
description.en: Reach ED05 from the eastern service path without crossing bedrooms, tea or the pool enclosure.

description.zh: 以实体围墙和内侧种植形成背景，不假定场地外有远山。
description.en: A wall and planting form the backdrop; no unselected mountain view is assumed.

description.zh: 南侧同样以墙和种植收边，具体材料和基地退界待定。
description.en: A southern wall and planting close the view; materials and real setbacks remain open.

description.zh: 1.5m通透种植屏界；不把茶窗外临时补成封死的高墙。
description.en: A 1.5 m planted screen, rather than an invented high wall immediately outside the tea window.

description.zh: 同高绿屏留一处1.2m步行门，内外庭院可以真正相通。
description.en: The screen includes a 1.2 m walking gate linking inner and outer gardens.

description.zh: 低绿篱标边，EG02步行门与EG03车行口分别接假想道路；不是实有道路或获批开口。
description.en: A low hedge with separate EG02 pedestrian and EG03 vehicle openings meets a hypothetical road, not a verified access approval.

description.zh: 以1.2m低绿篱收边，边界外不预设风景或可使用土地。
description.en: A 1.2 m hedge defines the foregarden; land and views beyond are not assumed.

description.zh: 保留原树位(3,11.5)与通透冠层；树种随城市气候、根域、落叶和维护确定，不将它冒认为已定桂树。
description.en: Retain the existing tree position and open crown. Select species for climate, roots and maintenance rather than silently calling it osmanthus.

spec.en: The modelled 4 m height is only a spatial placeholder.

description.zh: 放在外园而非挤进内庭；留冠幅、根域与落花维护空间，是否适种待城市和气候确认。
description.en: Place the candidate in the outer garden with crown, roots and flower cleanup space. Suitability awaits a real climate.

species.zh: 桂花 Osmanthus fragrans · 条件候选

spec.zh: 研究冠幅3–4.3m、高3–6m；并非定苗或栽植许可。
spec.en: Research range: crown 3–4.3 m, height 3–6 m; not a selected specimen or planting approval.

description.zh: 在外墙与内庭之间形成可维护的林下层次；不遮蔽门窗、步道和检修。
description.en: Layer maintainable planting between the outer wall and court without blocking windows, paths or service access.

spec.zh: 详细品种、密度、土壤与灌溉待现场。
spec.en: Species, density, soil and irrigation await the site.

description.zh: 泳池以自身四边围界隔离，不能借地界墙或主宅门替代；示意1.5m高围界、自闭自锁门、非攀爬构造、防滑与可视监督，实际高度、间隙、锁位和报警依当地要求专业核验。本图不宣称安全认证。
description.en: Use a separate four-sided enclosure, not a boundary wall or house door. The 1.5 m study includes a self-closing/latching gate, non-climbable detailing, slip resistance and supervision sight lines. Verify actual height, gaps, latch and alarms locally; this is not a safety certification.

description.zh: 1190㎡是假想用地。主宅200㎡建面/166㎡净功能；后期翼房另增72㎡建面/60㎡净功能，全部远景合272㎡建面/226㎡净功能。30㎡内庭、36㎡池水、54㎡池畔均为室外单列，不相加成室内面积。
description.en: The hypothetical parcel is 1,190 m². Core: 200 m² gross / 166 m² net. Later wing: 72 m² gross / 60 m² net. Full horizon: 272 m² gross / 226 m² net. The 30 m² court, 36 m² water and 54 m² deck remain separate outdoor areas.

label.en: Solitude bench by the osmanthus candidate

description.zh: 仅照亮门锁与脚下，不在池面制造眩光。
description.en: Light the latch and path, avoiding glare over the water.

description.zh: 在健身入口旁定位，不替代室内灯光设计。
description.en: A fixed light beside the gym entry, not a full indoor lighting design.

description.zh: 引导停留与回庭，避免上照树冠和窗。
description.en: Mark the resting route without uplighting crowns or windows.

description.zh: 露天停车旁的轻量收纳，不增加封闭车库。
description.en: Light storage next to open parking, without adding an enclosed garage.

label.zh: 同一面墙 · 从室内与庭院看

description.zh: W03全长6m、墙厚0.24m、墙顶2.70m；V06窗台0.15m、窗顶2.50m，D09门槛0/门顶2.50m。窗门间0.15m实垛不随影像改动；两面图为同一组尺寸，外观左到右与室内向南看镜像。
description.en: W03 is 6 m long, 0.24 m thick and 2.70 m high. V06 sill/head: 0.15/2.50 m; D09 threshold/head: 0/2.50 m. The 0.15 m pier is fixed. Both elevations use one dimension set and reverse for the south-looking interior view.

description.zh: 统一研究平屋面边缘：底2.70m、顶2.90m，向庭院挑0.45m；构造、防水、排水与受力尚待专业深化。
description.en: A shared flat-roof edge: soffit 2.70 m, top 2.90 m, 0.45 m projection into the court. Structure, waterproofing and drainage remain to be developed.

label.en: Through the sliding door to the court
Court south gate to outer garden
Pool gate and external path to changing

label.zh: 更衣区内部进入健身房
label.en: Changing through the internal gym door
